intro: Erion Shadewhisper is a straightforward summons sending emerging Alliance rogues into Darnassus. Delivered by Jannok Breezesong, the message directs travelers to the Cenarion Enclave where Erion awaits to push their efforts beyond local borders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do not worry, I am not sending you to see Syurna. Erion requires your presence at the Cenarion Enclave. Make haste!

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is time to branch out, traveler - the world awaits.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
